title: VoxGo v0.4.2
notes: Added Chinese/English language selection as the first setup step, with immediate wizard localization.
Added an overlay pause/resume button, a persistent paused indicator, and a highlighted border.
Localized pause/resume notices and tray controls, with a restore hint when hiding the overlay.
Kept VoxGo running when the overlay is hidden and added diagnostics when the system tray is unavailable.
notes_en: Added Chinese/English language selection as the first setup step, with immediate wizard localization.
Added an overlay pause/resume button, a persistent paused indicator, and a highlighted border.
Localized pause/resume notices and tray controls, with a restore hint when hiding the overlay.
Kept VoxGo running when the overlay is hidden and added diagnostics when the system tray is unavailable.
notes_zh: 首次设置新增中英文选择，向导即时切换语言。
浮窗新增暂停和恢复按钮、持续暂停标识及高亮边框。
暂停提示和托盘菜单支持中英文，隐藏浮窗时提示恢复方式。
隐藏浮窗后程序继续运行，托盘不可用时显示诊断提示。
